Late November 2024 (First) |virtual_item = {{Color|Other|Patient Zero}} skin for [[Accelerator]] |toy_type = Plushie }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Patient Zero Mini Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy. It was made by Juniper Creates™. The plushie offers the [[Patient Zero]] enemy. Anybody who bought the toy in the Merch Shop would receive the {{Color|Other|Patient Zero}} skin for the [[Accelerator]]. If bought on the [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games store], it will not come with any rewards. It is made out of plush fabric and polypropylene cotton, its size measures 7.9 inches (20.066 centimetres) tall, 5.9 inches (14.986 centimetres) wide and 6.3 inches (16.002 centimetres) deep. Its eyes, goggles and gear glow in the dark. A tree was planted for every order of the '''Patient Zero Mini Plush'''. ==Official Description== *'''Online (Third)''' *:Warning: Experiment escaped. Patient Zero has broken free from the lab and he is heading straight for your collection as a menacing mini plush. The in-game reward is only included with purchases made in Roblox. Items purchased from shop.paradoxum.games do not include an in-game reward. *'''Online (Second)''' *:Warning: Experiment escaped! Patient Zero has broken free from the lab and he’s heading straight for your collection as a menacing mini plush. *'''Online (First)''' *:Warning: Experiment escaped! Patient Zero has broken free from the lab and he’s heading straight for your collection as a menacing mini plush. But he's not alone— this plush comes with a FREE in-game skin!! ==Prices & Stores== Prices varied by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''Patient Zero Mini Plush''' could be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for $26.99. Previously, it had a cost of $24.99.
